summary: 72 findings ({'duplicate': 16, 'status': 19, 'website': 9, 'desc': 6, 'price': 3, 'hq': 3, 'group': 16}). Global WMS list is padded: fabricated/non-WMS entries (Fishtech/TempoWMS, TempoWMS Cold Chain, WHSControl, TechniCare ERP, Hopscotch, Wharehouser, StockPiler, TCS WMS, Grocy), many duplicates (Körber/HighJump x4 vs Infios, SnapFulfil vs Synergy, Extensiv/3PL Central/Skubana, Tecsys x2, Maves vs ViewPoint), defunct/renamed (Stitch Labs, Shipwire->Stord, Ware2Go->Stord, DEAR->Cin7 Core, Openbravo->Orisha, Whiplash->Ryder). Wrong websites: Cahoot (UK bank), Fabric (different company), Harris Affinity (L3Harris domain). Canadian fixes: ClearSpider HQ Mississauga, Zafin HQ Toronto.
